summary: Double currency adjustment leading to negative line on finalized invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightLayer AI received a finalized monthly invoice (2026-02) containing a negative line item of -€0.03 and a missing reserved-capacity prorated credit. The invoice shows the promotional trial credit applied, then an exchange rate adjustment column that appears twice producing the negative line.

Impact:
- Billing UI shows negative line on finalized invoice (confusing for finance teams).
- Customer reports discrepancy of €0.03 and missing reserved credit of €12.50 that should have offset the negative line.
- Customer is enterprise/dedicated and requests an explanation and corrective invoice.

Environment:
- prod:eu-west billing run for BrightLayer AI (org id redwood-cust-4432)
- Reserved capacity active for 2026-02 prorate window

Steps to reproduce (customer report):
1) End-of-month billing run finalized on 2026-03-01 for period 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28.
2) Trial promo credit applied on account earlier in cycle.
3) Late postback of 2026-02-28 reserved-hours came in on 2026-03-02 and system re-applied prorate adjustments.
4) Customer downloaded invoice PDF and noticed a -€0.03 line and no visible reserved-capacity prorate credit line.

Attached logs (from customer and initial support pull):
- Billing CSV (customer provided)
- Account ledger export (redwood-billing-service)
- Postback ingestion logs from 2026-03-02
steps_to_reproduce: Customer-facing: download finalized invoice PDF for 2026-02 period
Find line item with negative amount (-€0.03)
Compare ledger export to invoice lines
Look for reserved-capacity prorate credit line missing
logs: currency-service-exchange-2026-03-01.log: EUR->USD rate applied 0.915 then adjustment 0.915 (duplicate)
comments: 2026-03-09 10:18 - Ava Martinez (Support): Opened with customer-supplied invoice and ledger. Customer requests corrected invoice and explanation.
2026-03-09 13:45 - Jun Park (Billing Eng): Acknowledged. Kicked off quick ledger vs invoice diff job and flagged to payments team. Marked as P1/Sev1 due to enterprise impact.

2026-03-10 09:02 - Mei Chen (SRE): Found late postback arrived 2026-03-02; billing run had completed 2026-03-01. We have postback replay logic but edge-case double-currency-adjustment when promo credit present.

2026-03-11 15:30 - Finance (Stripe Ops): Confirmed invoice finalized; system created a corrective credit memo for -€0.03 while reserved-capacity credit was queued but not attached to PDF at finalize time.

2026-03-12 11:05 - Jun Park (Billing Eng): Issued corrected invoice inv-2026-02-4432-v2 and created waiver/credit to ensure customer ledger shows +€12.50 reserved credit and removes negative line. Customer notified.
2026-03-12 11:22 - BrightLayer AI (Customer): Confirmed receipt of corrected invoice and requested a short explanation for audit. Support provided summary and links to runbook.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: late postback after finalize caused out-of-order credit application
Observed currency-service applied exchange adjustment twice in billing pipeline during invoice generation when promo credit rows were present
Reserved-capacity prorate credit arrived as a separate postback and was queued; PDF generation skipped queued credits for finalized invoices leading to mismatch in PDF vs ledger
Reproduction: reran billing pipeline locally with synthetic late-postback and promo-credit; produced same -€0.03 negative line on PDF while ledger contained reserved credit
resolution: Root cause: race between end-of-day invoice PDF generation and late reserved-capacity postback combined with a bug that applied an exchange-rate adjustment column twice when promo-credit rows were in the interim ledger. Fixes applied: (1) hotfix to billing pipeline to dedupe exchange-adjustment rows during finalize (PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/commit/7f4b1c2), (2) patch to include queued reserved credits in post-finalize corrective PDFs, (3) created automated check in postback reconciler to surface late postbacks that affect finalized invoices. Customer outcome: issued corrected invoice inv-2026-02-4432-v2, created ledger credit of €12.50 for reserved prorate, and generated a credit memo to offset the -€0.03 line. Follow-ups: backlog ticket INT-990000 to harden invoice finalize window and add metrics to detect doubled currency adjustments; update runbook in Confluence. Customer confirmed resolution on 2026-03-12.
follow_up_actions: INT-990000: increase finalize window visibility and add alert for duplicate-exchange adjustments
Monitor eu-west billing runs for next 3 cycles for regressions
final_customer_message: 2026-03-12 12:00 - Support (Ava Martinez): Hi BrightLayer AI — we corrected your invoice (inv-2026-02-4432-v2) and issued the missing reserved-capacity credit. A root-cause bug was fixed and we added a reconciler alert. Apologies for the confusion; let us know if you need a statement for auditors.
